prompt: Please add chunk(list, size) that splits a list into consecutive lists of size items, the last one shorter when the length does not divide evenly: chunk([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2) is [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]]. The size must be a positive whole number; anything else is an INVALID_ARGUMENT error. Wire it up like the other list functions and add tests.
